name: Libration Balance Haven
core_rationale: Central gimbal-mounted basalt atoll town of Libration Mirror Shoals at [1, 1] where tide-cartographers balance the lunar mirror-pools above the Sunken Syzygy Dome.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Counter-weighted silver mercury basins that keep the town plaza level during lunar tilt

North.lock_message: Focused starlight glare from Crescent Reflector Reef blinds unshielded navigators; Tide-Balancer Selene requires the Syzygy Smoked-Glass Lens before unlocking the northern reef.

resident_npcs.name: Tide-Balancer Selene
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Libration Balance Haven! Even when the outer shoals tilt twelve degrees, my 0.58 meter tide-gauge desk stays perfectly level.

resident_npcs.name: Lens-Grinder Nyx
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Sunken Syzygy Dome, an abyssal prism-ray holds the Syzygy Smoked-Glass Lens needed to cross the northern Crescent Reflector Reef!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Libration Mirror Shoals at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's Sunken Syzygy Dome.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Gimbal-balanced basalt atoll plaza surrounded by sheet-silver tide mirrors.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m tide-gauge desks, 0.14m basalt risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Crescent Reflector Reef behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
